newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX EUROYEN, EURODOLLARS FIRM IN LATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX EUROYEN, EURODOLLARS FIRM IN LATE TRADE.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures were firm in late trade on Monday after a sell-off on the Japanese stock market while Eurodollars ended easier.
"There was a bit of flight to quality when the Nikkei cash index sank about four percent today. The March Euroyen tested a high of 99.25," a dealer with an Asian futures house said.
He said there was "little fundamental" in the Euroyen move upwards given the state of cash rates.
"But the undertone is a bit firm with a lot of uncertainty in the stock market," he said.
He expects the March Euroyen contract to be capped on the upside at 99.28 but it should find good support at 99.20 on the downside.
At 1115 GMT, the contract was unchanged at 99.23 against its IMM close on volume of 6,815 lots.
Japanese government bond futures for September settled at 126.62 against their previous at 126.59.
Eurodollar futures ended little changed after moving within narrow ranges.
Dealers said there was renewed concerns about higher U.S. interest rates could pressure Eurodollars in coming sessions though there was some short covering today.
"We are also looking at a technical downtrend after the sell off on bonds on Friday," a dealer said.
He said December Eurodollars looks set to head towards 93.95 while the March contract would head for 93.83.
December Eurodollars ended at 94.000 against an IMM finish of 93.985 on volume of 9,565 contracts while March ended at 93.900 against 93.885 on volume of 12,245.
